image_description: A street scene featuring a woman in colorful attire (pink hat, striped skirt) blowing large soap bubbles. The primary subject is a large, translucent bubble in the foreground exhibiting strong iridescence and background distortion. A second, smaller bubble is visible near her mouth. The background consists of a European-style stone building and pedestrians on a paved street.

While the visual cues suggest fragility, the actual physical property of being 'prone to bursting' cannot be tested in a static image unless it is currently bursting.
